title: Three scoping shortcuts that fail later

hotspots.label: Myth: 'the API has everything' is a finding.
hotspots.detail: It is a claim. Test it in the sandbox: pages, read groups, users, groups with members, and deletions.

hotspots.label: Myth: identity can be sorted out after launch.
hotspots.detail: Users must be indexed before they are referenced. Without identity data, you need a manual map of users to corporate identities.

hotspots.label: Myth: hosting is an operations detail for later.
hotspots.detail: Choose where the connector runs before you build: that decision determines how secrets, scheduling, and networking are handled.
